create_runner: create a GeneralizedRCNNRunner instance using create_runner with the d2go runner class name
build_detection_train_loader: build a detection training data loader from the runner using build_detection_train_loader with config
build_detection_test_loader: build a detection test data loader from the runner using build_detection_test_loader with config and dataset name
test_DiskCachedList: test DiskCachedList by creating a cached list from mixed data types and verifying indexed access
test_disk_cached_dataloader: test the disk-cached data loader by enabling disk cache config and iterating over train and test loaders
